description.en: The configuration ID. You can call the [ListRedirectRules](~~2867474~~) operation to obtain the configuration ID.

description.zh:
保留查询字符串。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to preserve the query string. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

description.zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
- 匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
- 匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
description.en:
The rule content. A conditional expression is used to match user requests. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
- Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
- Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq \"video.example.com\").

description.zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

description.zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。
description.en: The rule name. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration.

description.zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行。
description.en: The execution order of the rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

description.zh:
节点给客户端响应重定向地址时候使用的响应状态码。取值范围：

- 301
- 302
- 303
- 307
- 308
description.en:
The HTTP status code used when the node responds to the client with the redirect address. Valid values:

- 301
- 302
- 303
- 307
- 308
The target URL after the redirect.

description.zh:
重定向类型。取值范围：

- static：静态模式。
- dynamic：动态模式。
description.en:
The redirect type. Valid values:

- static: static pattern.
- dynamic: dynamic pattern.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa update-redirect-rule --site-id 1234560000 --config-id 35281609690000 --rule-name rule_example --rule-enable on --rule http.host_eq_video.example.com --type static --target-url http://www.exapmle.com/index.html --status-code 301 --reserve-query-string on --sequence 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa UpdateRedirectRule --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234560000 --Type static --RuleEnable on --ReserveQueryString on --ConfigId 35281609690000 --Rule 'http.host_eq_video.example.com' --TargetUrl 'http://www.exapmle.com/index.html' --Sequence 1 --StatusCode 301 --RuleName rule_example
